Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site maps, building sizes, ages, portables, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessments covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term needs into capital planning (Sections D, Figures 6-16, pages 25-44; Section E, Figures 18-19, pages 52-54).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with methodology explained; includes capacity utilization data by site and classroom; links enrollment projections to facility actions and discusses strategies for boundary changes and maximizing existing capacities; considers long-term implications including new high school planning (Sections C and D, pages 16-24, 25-51; Figures 3-5, 6-17).

Educational Alignment.justification: Positions educational alignment as a core principle; detailed analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including CTE, special education, STEM, and college readiness; connects facility projects directly to educational goals and program needs; includes strategic planning goals aligned with educational mission (Sections B and G; Career Technical Education program matrix and descriptions, pages 12-15; Strategic Planning Goals Appendix 1).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes some reference to outdoor spaces such as athletic fields and synthetic turf replacements; mentions site improvements and shade structures at some campuses; lacks districtwide data or comprehensive greening strategies; no detailed analysis of green space coverage or climate resilience framing (Section E, pages 52-54; project descriptions of athletic fields and shade structures).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges environmental factors indirectly through facility upgrades (e.g., HVAC, roofing, energy efficiency) but does not provide a detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive climate resilience strategies; no explicit climate readiness theme or districtwide climate risk mitigation plan found.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy-related upgrades such as HVAC system replacements, lighting improvements, and technology infrastructure enhancements; references to energy efficiency projects and compliance with state standards; discusses modernization and replacement of aging systems; lacks comprehensive energy resilience strategy or detailed energy use data (Sections D and E, pages 25-54).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive financial plan including detailed cost estimates, funding sources (developer fees, bonds, state programs, CFD taxes), and prioritization of projects; includes multi-year revenue and expenditure projections; aligns financial capacity with facility needs and educational priorities; includes contingency and escalation assumptions (Section E, pages 52-57; Facilities Report and Measure Q Bond Final Report Appendices).
